messages:
emma: Heads-up: I opened a docs PR after noticing a few inconsistent examples on /v1/generate — looks like both request params and the sample response shape were out of sync with OpenAPI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12789
liam: thanks. what were the concrete mismatches?
emma: two main things: 1) examples used `max_tokens` in several curl/python snippets but our runtime expects `max_new_tokens` (we changed naming during an internal migration). 2) sample response in the page shows `choices: [{text: ...}]` but the OpenAPI and SDKs use `outputs: [{text: ...}]`.
anya: ouch, that explains the confusion reported by a user who tried to map response fields to the SDK and couldn't find `choices`.
docs-ci-bot: docs-lint: failed 
- request example param `max_tokens` is not in the schema for /generate (expected `max_new_tokens`)
- response example property `choices` does not match OpenAPI response schema (expected `outputs`)
liam: good catch. Can you paste the corrected curl + minimal response sample so folks can eyeball?
emma: sure — corrected curl (note header normalization to lowercase too):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-1","input":"Summarize the meeting","max_new_tokens":80}'
```
emma: corrected minimal response (200):
```json
{
  "id": "gen_01F4...",
  "model": "redwood/fast-1",
  "outputs": [
    {"text": "Meeting notes: ...", "token_count": 78}
  ],
  "usage": {"input_tokens": 12, "output_tokens": 78}
}
```
liam: solid. Also agree on lower-case `x-request-id` — we've had proxies in the wild that are picky. Add a note under the endpoint docs that examples prefer lowercase header names for portability.
anya: can we add a short migration tip for users upgrading older examples that used `max_tokens`? e.g., "if you see `max_tokens` in older docs, map to `max_new_tokens` in requests"
docs-ci-bot: suggestion: add a changelog bullet and create a follow-up docs-test to snapshot example params and response keys to prevent regressions
emma: done in the PR: added changelog entry under "Docs" and filed issue to add snapshot tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4332
liam: for release coordination: if this docs PR causes any release-check flakiness, prefer reverting only the example text and push release forward; but I expect this to be non-blocking. CC @release-coordinator
release-coordinator: noted. please include the PR number in the release notes so customers can find the mapping note quickly.
anya: tiny nit: update the Python snippet to use `headers={"x-request-id": request_id}` and use `max_new_tokens` in the dict. small patch?
emma: done in the same PR. I'll rebase on main and push when tests go green. pinging reviewers for quick approval. Thanks! :tada:
